title: Wandrd’s Magnetic Camera Straps Are My New Favorite Accessory

claims.claim: Wandrd, Magnetic Camera Strap sistemini Perşembe günü piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: Wandrd—known for its camera bags—launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.

claims.claim: Wandrd'in Torus Links adı verilen dairesel ankrajları 198 pound'a kadar taşıma kapasitesine sahiptir.

evidence.quote: It features a circular anchor similar to Peak Design, called “Torus Links.” The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job.
It features a circular anchor similar to Peak Design, called “Torus Links.” The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds

claims.claim: Wandrd, ürün için iki yıllık garanti sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: (Wandrd offers a two-year warranty.)

claims.claim: Wandrd, Magnetic CoreLock sistemini tercih edilen kayışlara bağlamayı sağlayan DIY kitini 29 dolardan satışa sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: If you have a strap you love—maybe a fancy leather strap someone gifted you—Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.
Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.

claims.claim: Wandrd strap kiti 30-mm boyutu için 69 dolardan satılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69), a 15-mm “Lite
Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69)

claims.claim: Wandrd strap kitinin 15-mm Lite versiyonu 49 dolardır.

evidence.quote: a 15-mm “Lite
and a wrist strap ($39).

claims.claim: Ryan Cope, Wandrd şirketinin kurucu ortağıdır.

evidence.quote: “We're photographers ourselves, so we're constantly ideating, tinkering, thinking of ways that things can be better,” Ryan Cope, Wandrd cofounder, tells WIRED.
